description: Records the answer to an open clarification question raised for an anomaly case. It does NOT approve any correction (corrections are approved in the app).

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

suggestion_id.description: Optional: id of the suggestion of the question (clarification.suggestions[].id) that the answer is based on; the answer text is still required and stored as sent

name: answer-clarification
